content.short: RockX is a global node operator enabling businesses to build, scale, and stake with ease.
content.description: RockX delivers stable, secure node performance and cost-efficient node services for businesses operating across a wide range of blockchains, including Aptos, Arbitrum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Cronos, Ethereum, Fantom, Multichain, OP Mainnet, Polkadot, Solana, and Polygon. The platform also provides a comprehensive suite of innovative tools designed to simplify development, enable seamless scaling, and support staking across these networks, helping teams design, deploy, and grow robust multi-chain infrastructure with confidence and efficiency.
